news_cards.title: Pradhan Mantri Ne Quit India Movement Ke Sahidon Ko Shradhanjali Di
bullets: Pradhan Mantri Shri Narendra Modi ne Quit India Movement ke sabhi bhagidon ko yaad kiya aur unki himmat aur nishchay ko shradhanjali di.
Quit India Movement 1942 mein Mahatma Gandhi ke netritva mein shuru hua tha, jiske parinaamaswaroop desh ke swatantrata sangram mein naye urja ka sankalan hua.
Is ghatna ka mahatva Bharat ke swatantrata itihaas mein atyant vishesh hai, jo desh ke nagrikon ki swatantrata ki ladai ko darshata hai.

news_cards.title: National Biodiversity Authority Ne 33 Rajyon Aur Kendra Shasanon Ko 3.79 Crore Rupaye Vitarit Kiye
bullets: National Biodiversity Authority (NBA) ne 33 rajyon aur kendrashason ko Access aur Benefit Sharing (ABS) ke tahat 3.79 crore rupaye vitarit kiye hain.
Yeh rashi rajya biodiversity board aur kendrashas ke liye vitarit ki gayi hai, jismein ICAR-National Bureau of Plant Genetic Resources (NBPGR) bhi shamil hai.
ABS yojana ka uddeshya biodiversity ke sanrakshan aur upyog ke liye financial labh pradaan karna hai, jo desh ke biodiversity sanrakshan mein mahatvapoorn bhoomika nibhata hai.

news_cards.title: Centralised Public Grievance Redress And Monitoring System (CPGRAMS) Ka Naya Roop
bullets: Centralised Public Grievance Redress And Monitoring System (CPGRAMS) ne janata ke samasyaon ka samadhan karne ke liye ek naya roop liya hai.
CPGRAMS ke tahat sabhi kendriya mantralya, vibhag, rajya aur kendrashas ek hi manch par judte hain, jisse samasyaon ka samadhan tezi se ho sakta hai.
Is yojana ka uddeshya janata ke hiton ko dhyan mein rakhte hue, unki samasyaon ka samadhan karne ka hai, jo desh ke nagrikon ke liye atyant mahatvapoorn hai.

news_cards.title: Grih Mantri Amit Shah Ne Naye Aparadhik Kanunon Ko Teen Mahatvapoorn Sthambhon Par Aadhrit Bataya
bullets: Grih Mantri Amit Shah ne naye aparadhik kanunon ko teen mahatvapoorn sthambhon - praudyogiki, samay, aur vishwas par aadharit bataya hai.
In naye kanunon ka uddeshya nagrikon ko nyay pradaan karna hai, jismein praudyogiki aur samay ka vishesh mahatva hai.
Is yojana ka uddeshya desh ke nagrikon ko suraksha aur nyay pradaan karna hai, jo desh ke vikas mein atyant mahatvapoorn hai.
